issue.title: Spike a read-only bank feed (SimpleFIN or Teller) if the trial shows the weekly QFX download is the friction
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-kd.7 (bank epic wrap-up, note #3); follow-up 3 in
`plan:202611/bank_daily_acknowledgment.md`.

Conditional: do this only if the 2–4 week bank trial shows that the weekly manual Wells
Fargo QFX download (the Monday `Bank import` PRE chore → `bob bank import
~/Downloads/*.qfx`) is the friction. If the trial shows the friction is typing or
categorizing instead, cancel this task (the plan's Trial section says to drop categories
from the chore in that case, not to add a feed).

Spike: evaluate a read-only feed (SimpleFIN Bridge or Teller) against Wells Fargo
checking: posted-only transactions, stable transaction IDs usable as the import identity
(`sha256(alias + "\n" + bank_id)`), ledger balance for the balance proof, credential
storage that keeps no bank credentials or account numbers in the vault, and cost. Output
a recommendation; any implementation would feed the existing `bob bank import`
planner/journal rather than a new write path. This would also reopen the "weekly manual
download" cost the bank epic accepted.

task_type_fields.proposal: Evaluate SimpleFIN Bridge or Teller as a read-only Wells Fargo feed for bob bank import, only if the trial shows the weekly QFX download is the friction.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The bank epic chose a weekly manual QFX import for v1; a feed is conditional on trial evidence that does not exist yet.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-kd.7 proposed a feed spike as a conditional follow-up; the bank epic accepted a weekly manual QFX download as v1's cost.
